engine_cache_hit_signals.Candle: no standard cached_tokens field; belief + TTL + eviction only
engine_cache_hit_signals.MLX: no standard cached_tokens field; belief + TTL + eviction only
engine_cache_hit_signals.llama.cpp: no OpenAI-shaped cached_tokens in typical completions; belief + TTL + eviction only
engine_cache_hit_signals.vLLM: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens present on OpenAI-shaped responses (observed in onboarding evidence); preferred over belief when the agent reports cached_prompt_tokens

placement_relation: Prefix affinity is a refinement of warm-model placement (warm_for_task), not a competitor and not a second authority. Both sit below cheaper_class_online / cheaper_ask_online in claim ORDER BY. RankByCostThenPrefixAffinity is the unit-testable form of that rule.

control_arm_0pct.note: 0% shared-prefix is the control. A win here would mean the measurement is wrong. Stand-in cannot produce a TTFT number; only routing behaviour and ranking overhead are reported.
